name: a typed instruction becomes a checklist of done tasks
looks: A dark chat panel holds a single typed instruction bubble covering several tasks at once; a reply panel beneath fills in with a short plan and a checklist that ticks off one item at a time as each task completes.
build: glass-ui-flow: the instruction types on at a steady rate; the reply card fades up with its checklist items ticking on back.out one after another, each a fraction of a second apart.
sound: A soft typing clack, a tick per checklist item.
prompt: Show a single typed instruction in a chat panel that bundles several small tasks together, then a reply panel filling in with a checklist that ticks off one task at a time. Use it to show one instruction turning into several pieces of real, finished work.
